The '''Cambria system''' was a part of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the beverage known as [[Cambrian wine]].<ref name="Underworld">[[Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika 2|''Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika'' 2]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Cambrian wine]]|system=Cambria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Cambria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-10.<ref name="TEA" />
